thread:
nina: quick sync: migrating quota_label -> quota_ref_id. want minimal disruption to analytics dashboards.

rahul: main constraint: analytics.events is huge. propose no in-place updates. dual-write at ingestion + lookup table for joins.

maria: agree. create console.quota_ref_map(route_id, quota_label, quota_ref_id). analytics teams join to that map via a small MV.

ashwin: UX: console keeps label display. add a migration page showing percent routes resolved and dashboards using label filters. owner can opt dashboard into id-joins.

rahul: backfill plan: windowed by event_date, idempotent jobs tracked in backfill_jobs table. throttle per-tenant. skip windows with <1k events.

maria: emit telemetry: quota_mig.dualwrite_on, quota_mig.backfill_pct, quota_mig.read_fallbacks. alert if read_fallbacks > 1% for 1h.

deploy-bot: started backfill job 8801 tenant=acme window=2025-09-01T00:00:00Z->2025-09-01T01:00:00Z

rahul: failure modes: unmapped labels -> dead-letter table + operator UI to map. renames -> create new mapping, don't mutate old canonical ids.

maria: tests: staging dual-write 72h, MV equivalence checks for sample partitions, dashboard dry-run migration tool.

nina: rollout checklist: db migration, dual-write, staging canary, 2-week opt-in, progressive backfill for hot tenants. I'll draft PRs and runbook.

ashwin: OK. tag me on PRs. thanks everyone.
